name: Charge period type code
description: Code specifying a type of a charge period.

values.name: Per day
values.description: Per day The associated charge applies to each day the service is provided.

values.name: Per week
values.description: Per week The associated charge applies to each week the service is provided.

values.name: Per month
values.description: Per month The associated charge applies to each month the service is provided.

values.name: Per rental
values.description: Per rental The associated charge applies to the entire length of time the service is provided.

values.name: Per hour
values.description: Per hour The associated charge applies to each hour the service is provided.

values.name: Per minute
values.description: Per minute The associated charge applies to each minute the service is provided.
